finalists.label: Aggressive digital papillary adenocarcinoma
finalists.why: This candidate has strong for evidence, including downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes within loose stroma, and no against evidence.

finalists.label: Hidradenoma
finalists.why: This candidate has strong for evidence, including a lesion of the right nasal vestibule mucosa 5 years prior and biopsied and reported as a solid and cystic hidradenoma, and no against evidence.

finalists.label: Adnexal Tumor
finalists.why: This candidate has strong for evidence, including p63 positive, pancytokeratin positive, and p16 negative, and no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive for evidence, including downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes within loose stroma, which is a distinctive feature of aggressive digital papillary adenocarcinoma.
